source_policy_evidence.section: General Questions: Is content on sec.gov free? Do I need permission to reuse EDGAR content?
source_policy_evidence.finding: The SEC expressly includes EDGAR public filing content in content free to access and reuse.

source_policy_evidence.finding: The SEC permits copying and distribution of information on its site without separate SEC permission, with appropriate source citation; logos, artwork and trademarks have separate restrictions.
